page.layout: One page of running text, with no margin notes. Running head top left, page number top right. Below the text: a centred reference line, a catchword at the right and a signature at the left, then a printer's ornament (not transcribed).

main_text.p: çontroversia pertinet, interdum etiam exi-pso Doctrinarum instrumento. Ac haec tenenda sunt: Universaliter dicta interdum contrahenda sunt & restringenda ad certam speciem: Restringitur generalitas, ne sequatur absurdum vel absonus intellectus. Studiosi Legum videant loc. Nicol. Everhardi de Generalitate & Absurdo.

page.notes: The ornament below the text is a printer's device and is not transcribed. The catchword "INVI" ends in a mark that could be a hyphen or a stroke, so it is marked [?]. The printed "exi-pso" and "vide-ant" are hyphenated line-end breaks, kept as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout, including "surdo" and "sequatur". No marginal notes are visible on this page.
